title: Guild Assignments
description: A Magister's seat comes with a standing bill. The Circle keeps a running list of what it needs - reagents, recovered artifacts, phenomena somebody has to go and look at - and expects its own to work it down instead of drawing a stipend for nothing. Take the next assignment off Elara's list and clear it.

objectives.description: Take the next assignment off the Circle's standing list
objectives.notes: Random assignment generated based on current world state

objectives.description: Bring back the arcane essence the assignment is written against
objectives.notes: Was type `variable`, which nothing in the engine dispatched - the quest could be accepted and never finished. The Circle's standing list is now one honest, checkable thing: have the reagent in hand when you report back. `has_item` asks about the pack rather than counting pickups, so essence the player already carried counts.

objectives.description: Report back to Elara that the list is one shorter

notes: Fixed: `arcane_circle_magister` is a FLAG (mage_13_council_seat raises it), and it was sitting in `prerequisites`, which QuestManager reads as a list of completed QUEST ids - no quest by that name exists, so the quest was never available at all. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, where flags are actually checked. The `complete_task` objective was type `variable` with no dispatcher and is now a real `has_item` on arcane_essence. `is_repeatable` is still a field nothing reads: the engine gates repeats on `cooldown_days`, and what the Circle's list should cost in days is a design call nobody has made, so no number is invented here. Repeatable quest, Magister rank.
